input_binding.manifest_role: HANDOFF_MANIFEST describes these 33 files; older DELIVERABLE_MANIFEST is historical broader evidence

definitions.value_status: DER from hash-verified OBS/source-derived inputs; unresolved applicability Q
definitions.energy_unit: kWh; original cumulative counters differenced with sign retained
definitions.calendar_assignment: CURRENT endpoint recorded year; cross-year interval assigned wholly to current year
definitions.mask_rule: original adjacent 120s AND both counter endpoints finite for every named channel; no positivity filter
definitions.reference_condition: both original endpoints have ambient and heating flow; both pass native-cell guard and unchanged rating engine
definitions.source_blank_policy: No interpolation through missing native cells; no extrapolation; unchanged engine may fail more strictly at a rectangular edge
definitions.reference_statistics: arithmetic endpoint-sample Qh[kW], Pel[kW], COP means on exact same mask; previous/current shown separately; NOT interval-average powers or integrated reference energies
definitions.measured_statistics: signed counter increments on each exact mask/status/year/condition; H and whole E share the mask; CP/IH null unless required by mask
definitions.condition_grain: year x temperature-proxy x current ambient bin x current heating-flow bin x current return bin
definitions.proxy_semantics: heating indicated iff heating flow both endpoints and HW absent both; DHW indicated iff HW both and heating flow absent both; both/incomplete separate; no service-mode proof
definitions.zero_negative_heat: retain all electric consumption for dH<=1e-8 kWh; no standby/cycling/loss attribution
definitions.missing_CP_IH: unknown, never imputed zero; IH electricity not added to useful heat
definitions.backup_column: absent from original EOH2074 header; physical absence not established
definitions.hybrid_year_semantics: window energy uses year_start; exact support uses interval current-endpoint year, without splitting window energy
definitions.hybrid_statistics: pooled=sumH/sumE; home-balanced=mean of per-home sumH/sumE; descriptive heterogeneous systems, no WM50 calibration/independent validation
definitions.hybrid_tables: all 13 comparison source tables copied unchanged, including other categories; 6 condition/year/clock tables additionally filtered by explicit category
definitions.admission_policy: canonical E2 and B05_WM50_INSTALLED_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE unchanged; later defensible equivalent aggregate/calibrated transfer allowed; no new component-E1, perfect-year, boiler-free or mandatory holdout gate

remaining_applicability_question: Can a same-SH-service installed/rating electrical, thermal and duty boundary be defended for a declared target through a qualified aggregate or calibrated transfer with coverage and uncertainty? EOH2074 mixed SH/DHW, measured IH electricity, unknown controller/frequency and timing do not yet supply that mapping; heterogeneous hybrid ratios are descriptive.
